about.title: Go Aga Ditharabololo tsa Dijithale tse di Tsweletsang Dikgwebo Pele
about.description:
Oklut Technologies ke khamphani ya ditharabololo tsa thekenoloji e e tsepamisitseng mogopolo mo go thuseng dikgwebo go fetola dikgopolo go nna maitemogelo a a nang le bokao a dijithale. Go tswa mo phetogong ya dijithale le tlhabololo ya dirweboleta tse di itiretsweng go ya kwa marung, AI, go itirisa, le ditirelo tsa thekenoloji e e laolwang, re thusa mekgatlho go nolofatsa go raraana, go tokafatsa bokgoni jwa go dira dilo tse di bonolo, le go tlhama boleng jo bo nnelang ruri jwa dijithale />

cookieConsent.description: Re dirisa dikhuki go tokafatsa maitemogelo a gago a go batla. O ka amogela dikhuki tsotlhe, wa gana dikhuki tse di seng botlhokwa, kgotsa wa itebaganya se o se ratang. Dikhuki tsa botlhokwa ka metlha di kgontshiwa go tlhomamisa gore webosaete e dira sentle.

privacy.description: Kafa Oklut Technologies e kokoanyang, e dirisang le go sireletsa tshedimosetso ya gago le dikhuki ka gone.

privacy.managingPreferencesDesc: O ka sekaseka kgotsa wa fetola gore ke dikhuki dife tse o di letlang ka nako epe fela go tswa mo phaneleng ya go rata dikhuki.

section1.title: 1. Tshedimosetso e re e Kokoanyang
body: Re kokoanya tshedimosetso e o e nayang ka tlhamalalo (e e tshwanang le leina la gago le aterese ya imeile fa o romela foromo ya go ikgolaganya le rona kgotsa o tlhama akhaonto) le tshedimosetso e e kokoanngwang ka go itirisa ka dikhuki le dithekenoloji tse di tshwanang, tse di jaaka ditsebe tse o di etetseng, mofuta wa sediriswa le lefelo le le ka nnang teng.

section2.title: 2. Kafa re Dirisang Dikhuki ka Gone
body: Dikhuki tsa botlhokwa di nna di kgontshitswe ka gonne webosaete ga e kgone go dira sentle kwantle ga tsone. Di boloka nako le boemo jwa netefatso mme di gakologelwa ditlhopho tsa gago tsa dikhuki.

Dikhuki tsa tshekatsheko di re thusa go tlhaloganya kafa baeng ba dirisang saete ka gone gore re kgone go e tokafatsa. Dikhuki tsa go maketa di dirisiwa go go bontsha ditheko le matsholo a a maleba. Ditlhopha tseno di kgontshitswe fela ka tumelelo ya gago mme di ka fetolwa nako nngwe le nngwe go tswa mo phaneleng ya ditlhopho tsa dikhuki.

section3.title: 3. Motheo wa Semolao (GDPR)
body:
Re dirisa tshedimosetso ya motho ka namana mo metheong e e latelang ya semolao: tumelelo ya gago (ya dikhuki tse di seng botlhokwa le papatso), go dira ga konteraka (ya ditirelo tse o di kopang), tlamego ya semolao, le dikgatlhego tsa semolao fa ditshwanelo tsa gago di sa di fete. O ka nna wa gogela morago tumelelo nako nngwe le nngwe kwantle ga go ama go nna kafa molaong ga tshebetso e e dirilweng pele ga go gogela morago.
Ditshwanelo tsa Gago

section4.title: 4. Ditshwanelo tsa Gago
body: Go ikaegile ka lefelo le o leng mo go lone, o ka nna wa nna le tshwanelo ya go fitlhelela, go baakanya, go phimola, kgotsa go thibela go dirisiwa ga tshedimosetso ya gago, go gana go dirisiwa, le go rwalwa ga tshedimosetso. O ka nna gape wa tlhatlhela ngongorego kwa bothating jwa tlhokomelo jwa selegae sa gago.

section5.title: 5. Go Boloka Tshedimosetso le Tshireletsego
body: Re boloka tshedimosetso ya motho fela fa go tlhokega ka maikaelelo a a tlhalosiwang mo pholising eno. Re dirisa dikgato tse di maleba tsa setegeniki le tsa thulaganyo go sireletsa tshedimosetso ya gago kgatlhanong le go fitlhelelwa go go sa letlelelweng, go fetolwa, go senolwa kgotsa go senngwa.

section6.title: 6. Ditirelo tsa Mokgatlho wa Boraro
body:
Dikhuki tse dingwe di ka nna tsa setiwa ke batlamedi ba motho yo mongwe (ba ba jaaka dipolatefomo tsa tshekatsheko kgotsa tsa papatso) tse di re thusang go dirisa webosaete. Batlamedi bano ba dirisa tshedimosetso ka fa tlase ga dipholisi tsa bone tsa sephiri mme fela fa o dumetse mo setlhopheng se se maleba.

ai-robotics-solutions.heroBadge: Ditsamaiso tse di Botlhale tse di Ikemetseng
overview: Botlhale jwa Maitirelo le Diroboto di fetola tsela e mekgatlho e dirang ka yone, e dirang ditshwetso ka yone le e e tlisang boleng ka yone. Ditharabololo tsa rona tsa AI & Robotics di thusa dikgwebo go feta go itirisa ga setso ka go kopanya botlhale jwa maitirelo, go ithuta ka metshine, pono ya khomphiutha, go itirisa ga thulaganyo e e botlhale, le diroboto go rarabolola dikgwetlho tse di mosola tsa kgwebo.

Re tlhama ditharabololo tse di botlhale go dikologa dipoelo tsa kgwebo tse di ka lekanngwang. E ka tswa tlhokego e le go itirisa tiro e e boaboelediwang, go sekaseka dibolumo tse dintsi tsa tshedimosetso, go lemoga diphethene, go tshegetsa ditshwetso, kgotsa go tsenya diroboto mo ditikologong tsa go dira, mokgwa wa rona o lebile go ikanyega, go kgona go lekanyetsa, tshireletsego le boleng jwa kgwebo jwa nako e telele.
transformation: Mekgatlho ya segompieno e ntsha tshedimosetso e ntsi thata mme e dira ditiro di le diketekete tse di boaboelediwang letsatsi le letsatsi. AI le diroboto di ka fetola ditiro tseno go nna ditiro tse di botlhale, tse di itirisang tse di tokafatsang dipholo fa di ntse di letla badiri go tlhoma mogopolo mo maikarabelong a boleng jo bo kwa godimo.

Ditharabololo tsa rona di ka thusa mekgatlho go itirisa ditiro tse di boaboelediwang, go fokotsa go tsereganya ka diatla, go tokafatsa go nepagala, go sekaseka tshedimosetso e e raraaneng, go tshegetsa ditshwetso tse di bonako, go tokafatsa tiriso ya didirisiwa, go tokafatsa maitemogelo a bareki, le go aga ditsamaiso tse di botlhale tse di ka lekanyediwang.

overview: Go itirisa ga kgwebo go kgontsha mekgatlho go emisetsa ditiro tse di boaboelediwang ka diatla ka dithulaganyo tsa tiro tsa dijithale tse di lolamisitsweng. Ditharabololo tsa rona tsa go itirisa tsa kgwebo di thusa dikhamphani go tokafatsa dipholo, go fokotsa go raraana ga tiro, go fokotsa diphoso, le go tlhama dithulaganyo tse di tlhomameng mo mafapheng otlhe.
Re sekaseka dithulaganyo tsa tiro tse di leng teng, re lemoga dikgoreletsi, le go tlhama ditharabololo tsa go itirisa tse di golaganyang batho, ditiriso, tshedimosetso, le dithulaganyo tsa kgwebo.

Dithulaganyo tseno di ja nako e e botlhokwa ya badiri mme di ka tlisa ditiego, go sa tlhomamang le diphoso.

Mokgwa wa rona wa go itirisa o tlhomile mogopolo mo go tlhaloganyeng thulaganyo e e feletseng, go tlosa dikgato tse di sa tlhokegeng, go kopanya ditsamaiso, le go itirisa ditiro tse di nayang boleng jo bogolo jwa go dira.

overview: Disenthara tsa tshedimosetso di bopa motheo wa dikgwebo tsa segompieno tsa dijithale. Ditiriso, dipolokelotshedimosetso, ditsamaiso tsa kgwebo, dipolatefomo tsa tlhaeletsano, le ditirelo tsa botlhokwa tsa kgwebo di ikaegile ka mafaratlhatlha a a ikanyegang.

Ditharabololo tsa rona tsa lefelo la tshedimosetso di tlhomile mogopolo mo go tlhameng, go dira gore di nne tsa segompieno, di laole, le go tokafatsa ditikologo tsa mafaratlhatlha tse di agetsweng go nna teng, tshireletsego, go kgona go lekanyediwa, go dira, le go dira sentle.
transformation: Lefelo la tshedimosetso la segompieno le tlhoka go feta disefara le polokelo. E tlhoka mafaratlhatlha a a dirilweng ka kelotlhoko go ralala dikhomphiutha, go dira dineteweke, tshireletsego, maatla, go tsidifatsa, go bayaleitlho, go dira bekapo le go tsosolosa fa go nna le masetlapelo.
Re thusa mekgatlho go tlhama ditikologo tsa mafaratlhatlha tse di nonofileng tse di tshegetsang merwalo e e botlhokwa ya tiro le go tlamela ka motheo wa kgolo ya thekenoloji ya isago.

overview: Mekgatlo e hlahisa tlhahisoleseding e ngata haholo ka dikopo, ditransekshene, bareki, ditshebetso, disebediswa, le dipolatefomo tsa dijithale. Kgwetlho ga e tlhole e le go kokoanya tshedimosetso fela; ke go tlhaloganya tshedimosetso eo le go e fetola go nna botlhale jo bo ka dirisiwang.

Ditharabololo tsa rona tsa Cognitive Analytics & AI di kopanya ditshekatsheko tse di tsweletseng, go ithuta ka motšhini, botlhale jwa maitirelo, go dira tshedimosetso, le botlhale jwa kgwebo go thusa mekgatlho go dira ditshwetso tse di botoka.
transformation: Pegelo ya setso e bolelela mekgatlho gore go diragetseng. Ditshekatsheko tse di gatetseng pele di ka thusa go tlhalosa gore ke ka ntlha yang fa go diragetse, go lemoga se se ka diregang morago ga moo le go tshegetsa ditshwetso ka se se tshwanetseng go direga.
Re thusa mekgatlho go tlhoma ditikologo tsa tshedimosetso tse di fetang go bega ka tsela e e sa fetogeng go ya kwa tshekatshekong e e botlhale le tshegetso ya ditshwetso.

information-reporting-systems.heroBadge: Botlhale jo bo Kopaneng jwa Kgwebo
overview: Baeteledipele ba dikgwebo le ditlhopha tsa tiro ba ikaegile ka tshedimosetso e e nepagetseng go tsaya ditshwetso tse di nang le matswela. Ditsamaiso tsa rona tsa Tshedimosetso le go Bega di thusa mekgatlho go kokoanya, go rulaganya, go sekaseka, le go tlhagisa tshedimosetso ya kgwebo ka ditsamaiso tsa tshedimosetso tse di rulagantsweng, dipolatefomo tsa go bega, didesheboto, le dithulaganyo tsa tiro tsa go bega tse di itirisang.

Mekgatlho gantsi e na le tshedimosetso e e anamisiwang mo ditirisong, mo diseporeteshiting, mo dipolokelotshedimosetsong, le mo ditsamaisong tsa tiriso. Seno se dira gore go nne thata go tlhoma pono e e tlhomameng ya go dira ga kgwebo. Re thusa go kopanya metswedi ya tshedimosetso mo ditikologong tsa go bega tse di rulagantsweng tse di tlamelang ka tshedimosetso ya kgwebo e e ikanyegang, e e fitlhelegang, le e e tlhomameng.
transformation: Thulaganyo ya go bega ga e a tshwanela go bontsha fela dinomoro. E tshwanetse go thusa badirisi go tlhaloganya tiragatso, go lemoga mathata, go ribolola ditšhono, le go dira ditshwetso tse di nang le kitso.

Re tlhama ditikologo tsa go bega go dikologa tsela e mokgatlho wa gago o dirang ka yone, re tlamela ka dithulaganyo tsa tikologo tse di rulagantsweng tsa tshedimosetso-go-tshwetso tse di diretsweng maemo otlhe a botsamaisi.

customDevelopment.row1Eyebrow: Thomelo e e Tletseng ya Modikologo wa Botshelo
customDevelopment.row1Title: Tlhabololo ya Bokhutlo go ya Bokhutlong go tswa mo Ditlhokegong go ya kwa Sekaleng
customDevelopment.row1P1: Maiteko mangwe le mangwe a mašwa a dijithale a simolola ka ditlhokego tse di kgethegileng, dithulaganyo tsa tiro tsa tiro, le maikaelelo a togamaano a a ka se fitlhelelweng ke serweboleta se se lekanang botlhe. Re itsege ka go aga ditsamaiso tsa dirweboleta tse di itiretsweng, tse di dirang sentle gotlhelele go tswa kwa tshimologong.
customDevelopment.row1P2: Go tswa mo go ribololeng ditlhokego tsa ntlha le moakanyetso wa boagi jwa setegeniki go ya kwa tlhabololong ya agile sprint, go kopanngwa ga thulaganyo ya tikologo ya API, dipeipi tse di nonofileng tsa go dira diteko, le go tsenngwa tirisong ga maru ka go itirisa, ditlhopha tsa rona tse dikgolo tsa boenjenere di tsaya bong jo bo feletseng jwa modikologo wa botshelo jwa setlhagiswa sa gago.
customDevelopment.row2Title: Ditsamaiso tse di ka Lekanngwang tse di Agetsweng Kgolo ya Kgwebo
customDevelopment.row2P1: Re tlhama dipolane tsa dirweboleta tse di nonofileng tse di diretsweng go emelana le merwalo e e bokete ya tlhagiso. Go tswa mo ditirelong tse dinnye tsa dimojule le di-backend tse di tsamaisiwang ke ditiragalo go ya kwa melatswaneng ya tshedimosetso e e nang le bokgoni jo bo kwa godimo le di-API tsa GraphQL/REST, re aga dipolatefomo tse di lekanyang kwantle ga matsapa ape.
customDevelopment.row2P2: Ka go tlhoma dikhoutu tse di phepa, tsa dimojule tse di kopantsweng le diteko tse di itirisang le go ikobela melao ya tshireletsego e e tswelelang, re netefatsa gore motheo wa gago wa serweboleta o a tlhokomelwa, o a tlhatlhobiwa, e bile o siametse go fetoga ga nako e telele.
customDevelopment.row3Eyebrow: Netefaletso ya Boleng le Ditiro tsa Tlhabololo
customDevelopment.row3Title: Thomelo e e Bofefo ka Dipeipi tse di Itirisang
customDevelopment.row3P1: Mokgwa wa rona wa thomelo o tsenya yuniti e e itirisang, go kopanngwa, le teko ya go boela morago go tswa kwa bofelong go ya kwa bofelong mmogo le dithulaganyo tsa tiro tsa CI/CD tse di tsenngwang mo ditshoding (Docker, Kubernetes, AWS/Azure/GCP).
customDevelopment.row3P2: Ka dipontsho tse di bonaletsang tsa go taboga, go kgona go ela tlhoko ka nako ya mmatota, le lebelo le le kgweediwang ke dintlhakgolo, re netefatsa gore nako e bonako ya go tsena mo mmarakeng kwantle ga go senya tshireletsego, botsitso, kgotsa maitemogelo a modirisi.
customDevelopment.row4Title: Ditiro tse di Ikanyegang tsa 24/7 le Phetogo ya Nako e Telele
customDevelopment.row4P1: Go ya go tshela ke tshimologo fela. Re fana ka tlhokomelo e e matlhagatlhaga, tlhokomelo e e tshegediwang ke SLA, go tokafatsa mafaratlhatlha a kwa marung, go baakanya tiragatso, le go tsenngwa tirisong ga dikarolo tse di tswelelang.
customDevelopment.row4P2: Setlhopha sa rona sa boenjenere se dira jaaka katoloso ya tlholego ya mokgatlho wa gago, se netefatsa gore ga go na nako ya go ema le go tswelela pele ga thekenoloji mo mmarakeng wa gago.
customDevelopment.pillarsSub: Feleletsa bokgoni jwa mokgobo o o tletseng jo bo tlhamilweng go tsaya dikakanyo tsa gago go tswa go lefela go ya kwa tlhagisong.
customDevelopment.pillar1Desc: Tshekatsheko ya kgwebo e e tseneletseng, ditlhaloso tsa tiro, le go dira mmapa wa loeto lwa modirisi go tlhalosa melelwane e e tlhomameng ya tharabololo.
customDevelopment.pillar2Desc: Dipolane tsa maru tse di ka lekanyediwang, go dira sekao sa polokelotshedimosetso, go tlhama ditirelopotlana, le metheo ya tshireletsego e e sa tshepaneng.
customDevelopment.pillar3Desc: Ditiriso tsa segompieno tsa webo le tsa selulafouno tse di tletseng tse di dirilweng ka khoutu e e phepa, pabalesego ya mofuta, le maemo a UI a a tsibogang.
customDevelopment.pillar4Desc: Di-API tsa REST/GraphQL tse di nang le bokgoni jo bo kwa godimo, ditlhopha tsa di-webhook, dikgoro tsa tuelo, le go tsamaisanya ga ERP/CRM ga motho yo mongwe go go se nang mathata.
customDevelopment.ctaTitle: A o Ipaakanyeditse go Aga Tharabololo ya Gago go tloga ka Tshimologo go fitlha ka Tiriso?
customDevelopment.ctaSub: Molekane le Oklut Technologies go aga, go dira, le go dirisa polatefomo ya gago ya dijithale e e itiretsweng go tswa mo ditlhokegong tsa kgwebo go ya kwa bonneteng jwa tlhagiso.
customDevelopment.pillar5Desc: Go itirisa ga teko ka tsela e e gagametseng, teko ya morwalo/kgatelelo, ditshekatsheko tsa bokoa, le ditlhopha tsa teko tsa go boela morago.
customDevelopment.pillar6Desc: Dipeipi tsa CI/CD tse di itirisang, go rulaganngwa ga ditshodi (Docker/K8s), mafaratlhatlha jaaka khoutu, le ditokololo tsa nako e e sa direng sepe.
customDevelopment.pillar7Desc: Go ela tlhoko ka bonako ga 24/7, telemetry ya boitekanelo, ditshekatsheko tsa tiragatso, go baakanya tshireletsego, le tlhokomelo e e tswelelang ya SLA.
customDevelopment.pillar8Desc: Lebelo la dikarolo tsa ka metlha, go kopanngwa ga ditshekatsheko tsa tshedimosetso, go tokafatsa AI, le go dira dikago tsa segompieno.

processAutomation.eyebrow: Ditiro tsa Thulaganyo e e Botlhale
processAutomation.description: Go itirisa ga ditiro tsa kgwebo go tswa kwa bofelong go ya kwa bofelong, go kopanya go itirisa ga thulaganyo ya diroboto (RPA), go dira ditokomane ka botlhale, dienjini tsa melao ya kgwebo, le go kopanya tsamaiso.
processAutomation.row1Title: Di-Bot tse di Botlhale tsa Ditiro tsa Modumo o o Kwa Godimo
processAutomation.row1P1: Fedisa go tsenya tshedimosetso ka diatla go go boaboelediwang, go kopanya ditsamaiso tse di farologaneng, le go tsenya ditokomane mo tseleng. Re dirisa di-bot tsa RPA tsa kgwebo tse di dirang ditiro tse di rulagantsweng 24/7 ka selekanyo sa phoso ya lefela.
processAutomation.row1P2: Ka go golaganya digokagano tsa desekethopo tsa bogologolo, di-backend tsa SAP/ERP, le dipolokelotshedimosetso tsa kwa marung, di-bot tsa dirweboleta di golola setlhopha sa gago go tlhoma mogopolo mo maitekong a kgwebo a togamaano.
processAutomation.row2Title: OCR, Go Ithuta ka Motšhini le AI ya Tokomane
processAutomation.row2P1: Ka go itirisa go tsenya, go tlhaola, le go ntsha tshedimosetso mo ditshupamolato, dikonterakeng, ditokomaneng tsa boitshupo, le ditleleimi. Dipeipi tsa rona tse di tsamaisiwang ke AI di netefatsa masimo kgatlhanong le dipolokelotshedimosetso tsa ka fa gare le go tlhotlheletsa dithulaganyo tsa tiro tsa kamogelo tse di itirisang.
processAutomation.row2P2: Fitlhelela dikelo tsa go dira ka tlhamalalo tse di fetang 95% fa o ntse o fokotsa thata dinako tsa go dira go tswa mo malatsing go ya go metsotswana.
processAutomation.row3Title: Kamaganyo ya Dipolatefomo tse di Farologaneng go tswa Bokhutlong go ya Bokhutlong
processAutomation.row3P1: Golaganya CRM, ERP, HRMS, le di-API tsa banka go nna diphallo tsa tshedimosetso tsa nako ya nnete tse di kopaneng. Re diragatsa ditlhotlheletsi tse di tlhotlhelediwang ke ditiragalo, mela ya melaetsa, le ditshwari tsa fallback tse di itirisang.
processAutomation.row3P2: Tshedimosetso e elela sentle go ralala mafapha kwa ntle ga tsereganyo ya batho, go fedisa di-silo tsa tiro le ditiego tsa tlhaeletsano.
processAutomation.row4Title: Ditshekatsheko tsa Thulaganyo ya Nako ya Mmatota le Ditemogo tsa Kaizen
processAutomation.row4P1: Latedisa dinako tsa go diragatsa thulaganyo, dimmapa tsa mogote tsa dithibelo, makgetlo a diphoso, le ROI ya matlole mo dideshebotong tsa khuduthamaga tsa nako ya nnete.
processAutomation.row4P2: Ditlhatlhobo tse di tswelelang tsa go ithuta ka motšhini di ribolola ditšhono tse dišwa tsa go itirisa, di boloka kgwebo ya gago e dira ka bokgoni jo bo kwa godimo.
processAutomation.pillarsSub: Diboloko tsa go aga tse di netefaditsweng tsa ditiro tse di botlhale tsa kgwebo.
processAutomation.pillar1Desc: Dithulaganyo tsa tiro tsa dikgato tse dintsi tsa batho le tsa dijithale tse di rulagantsweng ka tsela e e itirisang le go oketsa.
processAutomation.pillar2Desc: Di-bot tsa serweboleta tse di theilweng mo melaong tse di dirang ditiro tsa go tsenya tshedimosetso ka tlwaelo, go kopanya, le go dirisa ditiriso tse di farologaneng.
processAutomation.pillar3Title: Boitiriso jwa AI jo bo Botlhale
processAutomation.pillar3Desc: Baemedi ba AI ba tlhaloganyo ba ba ranolang bokao, ba sobokanya sekwalwa se se sa rulaganngwang, le go dira ditshwetso ka go itirisa.
processAutomation.pillar4Desc: Meepo ya thulaganyo, go lemoga dikgoreletsi, le dithulaganyo tsa tiro tsa Kaizen tse di tswelelang go fokotsa ditshenyegelo tsa tiro.
processAutomation.ctaTitle: A o Siametse go Itirisa Dithulaganyo tsa Tiro tsa Kgwebo ya Gago?
processAutomation.ctaSub: Golagana le baagi ba rona ba dipolane tsa go itirisa go lemoga ditšhono tsa ROI e e kwa godimo le go dirisa dithulaganyo tsa tiro tse di botlhale tsa dijithale.

digitalTransformation.description: Go dira dithulaganyo tsa kgwebo tsa segompieno ka botlalo, dipolane tsa thekenoloji, le dikai tsa tiro go kgweetsa bofefo jwa mokgatlho, bokgoni jwa tiro, le kgolo e e tswelelang ya dijithale.
coreCapabilities: Dimotlolo tsa go Dira ka Bofefo
digitalTransformation.row1Title: Go tswa go Ponelopele go ya go Mmapa wa Tsela o o ka Diragadiwang
digitalTransformation.row1P1: Re dirisana le baeteledipele ba dikgwebo go tlhalosa leano la dijithale, dikgetse tsa kgwebo, le dimmapa tsa ditsela tse di nang le diphenyo tse di bonako le go diragatsa go go senang dikotsi.
digitalTransformation.row1P2: Dikgato tse di beilweng kwa pele, dikai tsa TCO, le di-KPI di netefatsa gore maiteko mangwe le mangwe a go tlhabolola thekenoloji a golagana ka tlhamalalo le dipoelo tsa lotseno, bokgoni, le kgotsofalo ya bareki.
digitalTransformation.row2Title: Dira Segompieno Kwantle ga go Thuba Kgwebo
digitalTransformation.row2P1: Di-monolith tsa polatefomo gape go ya kwa ditirelong tse dinnye, di-API, le diphethene tsa tlholego tsa kwa marung tse di nang le di-cutover tsa nako ya go sa dire le netefatso ya go boela morago e e itirisang.
digitalTransformation.row2P2: Re dira gore ditiriso, dipolokelotshedimosetso, le dikarolo tsa go kopanya di nne tsa segompieno fa re ntse re boloka kobamelo le boemo jwa tshireletsego.
digitalTransformation.row3Title: Go Amogela Maru le Botlhale jo bo Kgweediwang ke Tshedimosetso
digitalTransformation.row3P1: Amogela AWS, Azure, le GCP, aga dipeipi tsa tshedimosetso tsa segompieno, le go tsenya baemedi ba ba ithutang ka motšhini go kgweetsa ditshwetso tse di ikemetseng.
digitalTransformation.row3P2: Go tswa mo go eleleng ga ditiragalo tsa nako ya nnete go ya kwa dideshebotong tse di kopantsweng, phetogo e nna e e ka lekanngwang le e e tswelelang.
digitalTransformation.row4Title: Maitemogelo a Segompieno a Ditšhanele tsotlhe
digitalTransformation.row4P1: Tlhama sešwa maeto a bareki mo webong e e tsibogang, iOS, Android, le di-portal tsa go itirela tse di nang le digokagano tse di itebagantseng le wena.
digitalTransformation.row4P2: Boenjenere jwa polatefomo, telemetry, le di-loop tsa ditshwaelo tse di itirisang di dira gore boitshimololedi jwa dijithale bo tswelele pele.
digitalTransformation.pillarsSub: Dilever tse di tsepamisitsweng mo dipoelong tse di netefatsang boeteledipele jo bo tswelelang jwa dijithale.
digitalTransformation.pillar1Desc: Dipolane tsa phetogo ya dikgato tse di nang le go dira sekao sa dikgetse tsa kgwebo, puso ya boagi, le go latedisa dikotsi tsa dintlhakgolo.
digitalTransformation.pillar2Desc: Metheo ya maru a mantsi ya AWS/Azure/GCP, dipeipi tse di itirisang, le go kgontsha tshekatsheko ya tshedimosetso ya kgwebo.
digitalTransformation.pillar3Desc: Go itirisa ga thulaganyo ka botlhale, baemedi ba AI ba ba nang le tlhaloganyo, le telemetry e e bolelelang pele go tokafatsa ditiro tsa letsatsi le letsatsi.
digitalTransformation.pillar4Desc: Di-portal tsa dijithale tsa omnichannel tse di fetolang thata le digokagano tse di itebagantseng le tse di agilweng go boloka badirisi ka bontsi.

digitalTransformation.ctaSub: Molekane le Oklut Technologies ya phetogo ya dijithale e e dirwang ka dikgato, e e senang dikotsi e e bofilweng mo dipoelong tsa kgwebo tse di ka lekanngwang.

endToEndSolutions.eyebrow: Modikologo wa Botshelo wa Thekenoloji o o Feletseng
endToEndSolutions.description: Letlhomeso le le rulagantsweng, la thebolo ya botshelo jo bo tletseng le le akaretsang ditlhokego tsa kgwebo, moakanyetso wa boagi, boenjenere, go kopanngwa, netefatso ya boleng, go tsenngwa tirisong kwa marung, le ditiro tse di laolwang.
coreCapabilities: Tlhabololo ya Mokgobo o o Tletseng
Go Tsenngwa Tirisong le go Phasaladiwa
endToEndSolutions.row1Title: Ditlhokego tsa Boenjenere le Moakanyetso wa Tharabololo
endToEndSolutions.row1P1: Dikokoano tsa tirisanommogo, go dira mmapa wa lefelo la kgwebo, le ditlhaloso tsa boagi jwa maru tse di diretsweng go fedisa kotsi pele ga mola wa khoutu o kwalwa.
endToEndSolutions.row1P2: Re tlhalosa dikai tsa tshedimosetso, matlhomeso a tshireletsego, le dintlhakgolo tsa go kgona go lekanyetsa tse di tlhomang katlego ya paka e telele.
endToEndSolutions.row2Title: Tlhabololo ya Mokgobo o o Tletseng le Teko e e Itirisang
endToEndSolutions.row2P1: Ditirelo tse dinnye tsa dimojule, di-API tse di babalesegileng mo mofuteng, le di-frontend tse di tsibogang tse di kopantsweng le ditshekatsheko tsa yuniti e e itirisang, go kopanngwa, le tshireletsego.
endToEndSolutions.row2P2: Dipeipi tsa go kopanya tse di tswelelang le Ditiro tsa GitHub, Terraform, le dithibelo tsa tshireletso tse di itirisang.
endToEndSolutions.row3Title: Go Tsenngwa Tirisong mo Marung le Go Tlhokomela go go Laolwang 24/7
endToEndSolutions.row3P1: Go rulaganngwa ga maru a mantsi mo AWS/Azure/GCP ka go boela morago ka go itirisa, go kgaola nako ya go sa dire sepe, le go kgona go ela tlhoko ka nako ya mmatota.
endToEndSolutions.row3P2: Re tlamela ka tlhokomelo e e tshegediwang ke SLA le go bayaleitlho go go tswelelang pele ga telemetry go fetola setlhagiswa sa gago kwantle ga mathata.
endToEndSolutions.row4Title: Puso e e Kopaneng le Tshegetso e e Tswelelang
endToEndSolutions.row4P1: Boikarabelo jwa ntlha e le nngwe go ralala mokgobo otlhe wa gago wa dijithale — lebelo la go taboga le le bonaletsang, tekanyetsokabo e e ka bonelwang pele, le boitshimololedi jo bo tswelelang.
endToEndSolutions.row4P2: Go phatlalatsa dikarolo ka metlha le ditikologo tsa go dira gore kgwebo ya gago e nne e le kwa pele ga kgaisano.
endToEndSolutions.pillarsTitle: Dipilara tsa Letlhomeso la Modikologo wa Botshelo
endToEndSolutions.pillarsSub: Kgato nngwe le nngwe e dirilwe ka tlhoafalo ya kgwebo.
endToEndSolutions.pillar1Desc: Go ribololwa ga domeine, dimmapa tsa ditsela tsa boagi, le go tlhamalatsa bannaleseabe go fedisa dikotsi tsa tiragatso.
endToEndSolutions.pillar2Desc: Ditirelopotlana tse di nonofileng tsa kwa marung, dikopantsho tsa API, le teko e e tswelelang ya QA.
endToEndSolutions.pillar3Desc: Go ikobela tshireletsego ya go sa ikanyege, ditokololo tse di tsenngwang mo ditshoding, le go tsenngwa tirisong ga maru ka go itirisa.
endToEndSolutions.pillar4Desc: Go ela tlhoko SLA ka 24/7, thelemetry ya boitekanelo, le boenjenere jo bo tswelelang jwa thutotlhagelelo.
endToEndSolutions.ctaTitle: A o tlhoka Molekane yo o Feletseng wa Modikologo wa Botshelo?
endToEndSolutions.ctaSub: Re beng ba modikologo wa botshelo o o feletseng wa thekenoloji gore setlhopha sa gago se kgone go tlhoma mogopolo mo dipoelong tsa konokono tsa kgwebo.

migrationServices.description: Go fuduga go go sireletsegileng, go go rulagantsweng ga ditiriso tsa bogologolo, dipolokelotshedimosetso, le mafaratlhatlha go ya kwa dipolaneteng tsa segompieno tsa maru, go kopantswe le go tswelela go dira dilo tsa segompieno gore go nne le bofefo le bokgoni jo bo tokafaditsweng.
coreCapabilities: Go dira gore Tiriso e nne ya Segompieno
migrationServices.row1Title: Leano la Maru a mantsi le go Tsholetsa le go Tokafatsa
migrationServices.row1P1: Go fuduga ga tiro go go se nang mathata mo AWS, Azure, le Google Cloud ka go ribolola ka go itirisa, go rulaganya makhubu, le go sa kgoreletsege ga kgwebo.
migrationServices.row1P2: Re lekalekanya go amogela gape, go dira dipolatefomo sešwa, le go dira dipolatefomo sešwa go tokafatsa ditshenyegelo tsotlhe tsa go nna mong (TCO) le go nna bofefo.
migrationServices.row2Title: ETL e e Sireletsegileng le Netefatso ya Tshedimosetso e e Itirisang
migrationServices.row2P1: Poeletso ya polokelotshedimosetso e e itirisang, thanolo ya sekema, le dipeipi tsa ETL tse di nang le bokgoni jo bo kwa godimo tse di nang le netefatso ya bothokgami jwa tshedimosetso ya 100%.
migrationServices.row2P2: Go ikatisa ga go kgaola ga nako ya go sa dire go netefatsa go tlhomama go go feletseng ga tshedimosetso le go tswelela ga kgwebo.
migrationServices.row3Title: Go Tsenya mo Ditshoding le go Rulaganya Dipina tsa Kubernetes
migrationServices.row3P1: Go dira gore di-monolith tsa bogologolo di nne ditirelo tse dinnye tse di ka lekanyediwang tse di rulagantsweng ka Kubernetes (EKS, AKS, GKE) tse di nang le dipolane tsa IaC tse di itirisang.
migrationServices.row3P2: Go dira porofaele ya tiragatso morago ga go fuduga le go tokafatsa ditshenyegelo go netefatsa ROI ya ka bonako.
migrationServices.row4Title: Diteko tse di Itirisang le Dinete tsa Pabalesego tsa go Busetsa Morago
migrationServices.row4P1: Dibuka tsa go kgaola tse di lekilwe mo ntweng, di-suite tsa go boela morago tse di itirisang, le mekgwa ya go boela morago ka bonako gore o nne le kagiso e e feletseng ya mogopolo.
migrationServices.row4P2: Telemetry ya boitekanelo morago ga go fuduga le tlhokomelo e e feteletseng ya 24/7 di netefatsa botsitso jwa tlhagiso jo bo senang selabe.
migrationServices.pillarsSub: Dikgato tse di senang kotsi tse di tshegediwang ke di-SLA tsa kgwebo.
migrationServices.pillar1Title: Kgaotso ya Nako ya go Ikhutsa ya Lefela
migrationServices.pillar1Desc: Canary e golola le go tsamaisanya ga go kwala gabedi ga polokelotshedimosetso go netefatsa gore modirisi o kgona go bona dilo ka tsela e e sa kgorelediweng.
migrationServices.pillar2Title: Netefatso ya Tshedimosetso e e Itirisang
migrationServices.pillar2Desc: Dipapiso tsa Checksum, ditlhatlhobo tsa bothokgami jwa sekema, le poelano ya ETL e e itirisang.
migrationServices.pillar3Title: Dinete tsa Pabalesego tsa go Busetsa Morago
migrationServices.pillar3Desc: Diporothokholo tse di gagametseng tsa go tsosolosa morago ga masetlapelo le dithutiso tsa go ikatisa go thibela kotsi mo legatong lengwe le lengwe.
migrationServices.pillar4Desc: Go tlhomamisa bogolo jwa maru, dipholisi tsa go lekanyetsa ka go itirisa, le didesheboto tsa taolo ya ditshenyegelo di akareditswe.

pilotPrototyping.eyebrow: Netefatso ya ka bonako le go kgonega
pilotPrototyping.description: Tlhabololo e e bonako le netefatso ya ditharabololo tsa thekenoloji go sekaseka go kgonega ga setegeniki, boleng jwa kgwebo, ditlhokego tsa go kopanya, tiragatso, le go kgona go lekanyetsa pele ga go tsenngwa tirisong ka botlalo.
pilotPrototyping.row1Title: Go tswa go Kgopolo go ya go Kgonagalo e e Netefaditsweng
pilotPrototyping.row1P1: Go fetola kakanyo go nna tharabololo ya selekanyo sa kgwebo go tlhoka netefatso e e gagametseng kwa pele. Tirelo ya rona ya PoC & Pilot e sekaseka go kgona ga thekenoloji, e dira diteko tsa kgatelelo ya maikutlo dihuku tse di botlhokwa tsa go kopanya, le go netefatsa ROI ya kgwebo pele ga maitlamo a magolo a matlotlo.
pilotPrototyping.row1P2: Re aga di-MVP tsa boikanyegi jo bo kwa godimo le difofane tsa sandbox tse di tsepameng tse di supang go kgonega ga setegeniki, go lekanya go diega ga tsamaiso, le go kokoanya netefatso e e tlhamaletseng ya bannaleseabe go sa le gale.
pilotPrototyping.row1Cap: Go Dira Sekao sa MVP ka Bofefo le Ditekanyetso tsa Setegeniki
pilotPrototyping.row2Title: Di-MVP tse di dirisanang le Netefatso ya UX
pilotPrototyping.row2P1: Re aga diforeime tsa megala tse di dirisanang, diphallo tsa badirisi tse di ka tobediwang, le bosupi jo bo dirang jwa dikgopolo ka malatsi, e seng dikgwedi. Leka ditirisano tsa mmatota tsa badirisi, tokafatsa diphethene tsa UI/UX, mme o kokoanye ditshwaelo tse di ka tsewang kgato go tswa mo bannaleseabeng.
pilotPrototyping.row2P2: Ka go khutshwafatsa di-loop tsa ditshwaelo ka nako ya tlhabololo ya ntlha, setlhopha sa gago se fokotsa go dira gape le go tlhoma ditlhaloso tse di tlhamaletseng tsa setegeniki pele ga dikgato tsa go aga tse di tlhokang madi a mantsi di simolola.
pilotPrototyping.row2Cap: Poeletso e e Bofefo le Diporototaepe tsa UX tse di ka Tobediwang
pilotPrototyping.row3Eyebrow: Kopanyo le Teko ya go Lekanngwa
pilotPrototyping.row3Title: Dikopano tsa Tsamaiso e e Raraaneng e e Tlosang Dikotsi
pilotPrototyping.row3P1: Ribolola dikgoreletsi tsa setegeniki, dikgoreletsi tsa API, le dikgoreletsi tsa tiragatso pele ga boineelo jo bo tletseng jwa letlotlo. Setlhopha sa rona sa boenjenere sa tekeletso se dira diteko tsa go kopanya kgatelelo ya maikutlo, dipeipi tsa tshedimosetso, le di-API tsa motho yo mongwe mo ditikologong tse di kgaoganeng tsa sandbox.
pilotPrototyping.row3P2: Phokotso eno ya dikotsi e e dirang e netefatsa gore tsamaiso e nna teng thata, go ikobelwa ga tshireletsego, le dinako tsa tlhabololo tse di ka bonelwang pele fa o fetolela PoC ya gago go nna tlhagiso ya kgwebo.
pilotPrototyping.row3Cap: Kopanyo ya Lebokoso la Motlhaba le Teko ya Kgatelelo
pilotPrototyping.row4Eyebrow: Tekeletso ya Tlhagiso e e Laolwang
pilotPrototyping.row4Title: Go Simololwa ga Tekeletso e e Ikaeletsweng le Netefatso ya Kgetse ya Kgwebo
pilotPrototyping.row4P1: Dirisa ditokololo tsa teko tse di lebilweng mo karolong e e tlhophilweng ya modirisi kgotsa mo mmarakeng wa teko. Latedisa dimeteriki tsa tiragatso, ditshekatsheko tsa kamogelo ya badirisi, le ditshwaelo tsa tiro go lekanya boleng jwa kgwebo le go tlhoma kgetse ya kgwebo e e tshegediwang ke tshedimosetso.
pilotPrototyping.row4P2: Ka dintlha tsa nnete tsa teko, barotloetsi ba khuduthamaga ba bona dimeteriki tse di tlhapileng tsa ROI go buelela tiriso e e anameng le dipeeletso tsa phetogo ya dijithale tsa togamaano.

pilotPrototyping.pillar1Desc: Go tlisa diporototaepe tse di dirang ka bonako go netefatsa ditshitshinyo tsa boleng go sa le gale mo modikologong wa botshelo.
pilotPrototyping.pillar2Desc: Netefatsa go tsamaisana ga API, melelwane ya go feta, le dikgoreletsi tsa kobamelo mo ditikologong tsa sandbox.
pilotPrototyping.pillar3Desc: Etsisa morwalo wa tlhagiso go tlhomamisa melelwane ya bokgoni le go tlhomamisa bogolo jwa kago ya maru.
pilotPrototyping.pillar4Desc: Lekanyetsa ROI e e bonalang le dimeteriki tsa ntshodikuno go tshegetsa ditshwetso tsa go phasalatsa kgwebo ka bophara.
pilotPrototyping.ctaTitle: A o siametse go netefatsa tharabololo ya gago e e latelang ya dijithale?
pilotPrototyping.ctaSub: Golagana le setlhopha sa rona sa boenjenere jwa ditharabololo go sekaseka ditlhokego tsa porojeke ya gago, go aga sekao, le go leka go kgonega ka kotsi ya lefela.

aiRobotics.heroHeading: AI le Diroboto di dira mmogo
aiRobotics.intro: Botlhale jwa Maitirelo (AI) le Diroboto di fetola tsela e dikgwebo di dirang ka yone ka go kopanya go dira ditshwetso ka botlhale le go itirisa ga maemo a a kwa godimo. AI e dira gore metšhine e kgone go sekaseka tshedimosetso, go ithuta diphethene le go dira ditshwetso tse di botlhale, fa diroboto tsone di tlisa bokgoni jono mo lefatsheng la mmatota gore di kgone go dira ditiro ka lobelo, ka nepo le ka tsela e e tlhomameng.
aiRobotics.section1Heading: E agilwe go lolamisa tiro nngwe le nngwe
aiRobotics.section1Text: Ditharabololo tsa rona tsa AI le tsa Diroboto di thusa mekgatlho go lolamisa ditiro, go fokotsa maiteko a go dira ka diatla, le go tokafatsa dipholo mo madirelong a a farologaneng. Ho tloha tshebetso ya boitiriso le ditshekatsheko tsa ponelopele ho ya ho diroboto tse bohlale le dithulaganyo tse bohlale, re fana ka dithekenoloji tse ntjha tse ntlafatsang bokgoni, di kganna kgolo, le ho tshehetsa phetoho ya dijithale.

aiRobotics.section2Text: Mong le e mong tshebedisano, qeto, le motsamao o matlafatsoa ke tsamaiso e le 'ngoe e amanang — ho fetola ya data ho diphetho ka nako ea sebele.

informationReporting.heroTitle: Tshedimosetso le Ditsamaiso tsa go Bega
informationReporting.heroSubtitle: Motswedi o le mongwe wa boammaaruri wa lefapha lengwe le lengwe — o o agilweng go fetola tshedimosetso e e tala ya tiro go nna ditshwetso tse kgwebo ya gago e ka di tsayang gompieno.
informationReporting.section1Heading: Thulaganyo e le nngwe e e kopantsweng ya meteriki mongwe le mongwe o o botlhokwa
informationReporting.section1P1: Tshedimosetso le Ditsamaiso tsa go Bega ke ditharabololo tsa botlhokwa tsa kgwebo tse di kgontshang mekgatlho go kokoanya, go laola, le go fetola tshedimosetso go nna dintlha tse di nang le bokao. Ditsamaiso tseno di kopanya tshedimosetso go tswa kwa mafapheng a le mantsi, di netefatsa gore go fitlhelelwa tshedimosetso e e botlhokwa ya kgwebo e e nepagetseng, e e tlhomameng, le ka nako ya mmatota. Ka go tlamela ka sethala se se kopantsweng sa taolo ya tshedimosetso, mekgatlho e ka tokafatsa go bonala ga tiro, ya lolamisa tsamaiso ya tiro, le go tshegetsa go tsaya ditshwetso ga togamaano mo maemong otlhe a kgwebo.
informationReporting.section1P2: Ditsamaiso tseno di dirisa dipego tse di itirisang, ditshekatsheko, le didesheboto go latedisa tiro, go ela tlhoko dimeteriki tsa konokono, le go tlhagisa dipego tsa nako ya mmatota. Ka go fokotsa maiteko a go dira ka diatla le go tokafatsa go nepagala ga tshedimosetso, dikgwebo di ka dira ditshwetso ka bonako le ka tsela e e nang le matswela.
informationReporting.section2Heading: E diretswe go bonala, go ikobela melao, le selekanyo
informationReporting.section2Text: Ka go bonala go go tokafaditsweng, go ikobela melao, le tirisanommogo, Ditsamaiso tsa Tshedimosetso le Dipegelo di kgontsha mekgatlho go tokafatsa dithulaganyo, go tokafatsa tlhagiso, le go kgweetsa kgolo e e tswelelang ya kgwebo mo tikologong e e nang le kgaisano.
informationReporting.ctaHeading: Fa setlhopha sengwe le sengwe setshwantsho se se tshwanang sa nako ya mmatota sa kgwebo.
informationReporting.ctaText: Bona kafa Ditsamaiso tsa Tshedimosetso tsa Nexus di ka kopanyang dipegelo tsa gago ka gone go nna polatefomo e le nngwe e e botlhale.

businessTransformation.sec1Heading: Go Tsamaisa Bothata mo Kgwebong e e Golang
businessTransformation.sec1Subtext: Fa dikgwebo di ntse di gola, dithulaganyo tsa tikologo tsa thekenoloji di a atologa. Se se simololang e le ditharabololo tse di tsepameng tsa mafapha ka bongwe se ka fetoga go nna webo e e tlhakaneng tlhogo ya ditsamaiso tse di sa tshwaneng.
businessTransformation.sec2Heading: Ponagalo e e Raraaneng ya Thekenoloji
businessTransformation.sec2Subtext: Fa ditiriso tsa kgwebo, dipolokelotshedimosetso, le ditsamaiso tsa tiriso di fetoga ka go ikemela, kelelo ya tshedimosetso e a kgaogana. Go tlhaloganya go kgaogana gono ke kgato ya ntlha e e botlhokwa thata.
businessTransformation.sec3Subtext: Dikgwebo di tsamaela kwa thulaganyong e e tsamaisiwang ke ditiragalo, ya API-first moo tshedimosetso e elelang ka tsela e e ikanyegang go ralala dipolatefomo tsa konokono mme e fitlhelela batsayaditshwetso ka nako ya mmatota.
businessTransformation.sec4Heading: Tshedimosetso e e Golagantsweng le Ditshekatsheko
businessTransformation.sec4Subtext: Fa ditiriso tsa kgwebo di buisana kwantle ga mathata, tshedimosetso e kgaotsa go nna setlhagiswa sa go bega mme e nna mokgweetsi yo mogolo wa bofefo jwa tiro.
businessTransformation.sec5Subtext: Pono e e akaretsang ya mafelo a konokono a thekenoloji a a bopang motheo wa kgwebo wa segompieno, o o ka lekanyediwang.
businessTransformation.sec6Subtext: Go dira gore thulaganyo ya tiriso e nne ya segompieno le go golaganya tshedimosetso e e kgaoganeng go tlisa ditokafatso tse di bonalang tsa tiro go ralala mokgatlho.
businessTransformation.ctaHeading: A o Siametse go Dira Tikologo ya Gago ya Thekenoloji ya Segompieno?
businessTransformation.ctaDescription: Batlisisa ka moo thulaganyo ya tiriso ya segompieno, tshedimosetso e e golagantsweng le thekenoloji e e ka lekanyediwang di ka thusang mekgatlho go tokafatsa bokgoni le go ipaakanyetsa kgolo ya isago.
businessTransformation.sec1P1: Mo tikologong e e tlwaelegileng ya kgwebo, kgolo gantsi e tlhagisa dikokomana tse dintsi tsa dirweboleta. Ditšhelete, ketane ya tlamelo, tirelo ya bareki, le ditiro tsa kwa tshimong gantsi di dira mo ditlhopheng tse di farologaneng tsa dirweboleta tse di bonweng kgotsa tse di agilweng ka dinako tse di farologaneng. Ho feta lilemo tsa phetoho ea tshebetso, dithulaganyo tsena ntshetsa pele difomate tsa bona tsa data, ntjhafatsa cadences, le ho kopanya quirks.

businessTransformation.modernArchitectureTitle: Mmotlolo wa Tiriso ya Kgwebo e e Golagantsweng
businessTransformation.sec3P1: Popego ya tiriso ya segompieno e emisetsa dikgolagano tse di thubegang tsa ntlha-go-ntlha ka motheo o o bofefo, o o sa kopaneng. Ka go tlhoma API e e nonofileng le lera la go kopanya, ditsamaiso di dirisana ka dintlha tsa bofelo tse di laolwang, tse di sireletsegileng fa di ntse di boloka boipuso jwa diyuniti tsa kgwebo ka bongwe.
businessTransformation.sec3P2: Bokgoni jwa konokono jwa setegeniki jwa phetogo eno ya boagi bo akaretsa:

sec3List.text: Go kgaoganya tlhaloganyo ya konokono ya kgwebo go nna ditirelo tsa dimojule tse di ka lekanyediwang.
Go tlhoma digokagano tse di tlhomamisitsweng, tse di kwadilweng tsa tirisanommogo ya ka fa gare le ya balekane.

sec3List.bold: Go kopanya tshedimosetso le go tokafatsa polokelotshedimosetso:
sec3List.text: Go kopanya dipeipi tsa tshedimosetso tse di dirang ka go tokafatsa dipotso tsa dipholo tse di kwa godimo.

sec3List.bold: Go kgona go ela tlhoko le tshireletsego:
sec3List.text: Go tsenya tirisong thelemeteri e e kopantsweng, ditsela tsa boruni, le ditaolo tsa phitlhelelo tse di ikaegileng ka seabe mo ditirelong tsotlhe.

businessTransformation.sec4P1: Metheo e e kopantsweng ya tshedimosetso e fetola ka moo boeteledipele le ditlhopha tsa tiro di dirisanang ka teng le tshedimosetso. Go na le go ikaega ka dipegelo tsa go leba kwa morago tse di bontshang se se diragetseng dibeke tse di fetileng, mekgatlho e bona telemetry e e dirang ka tlhamalalo go ralala diyuniti tsa kgwebo.
businessTransformation.sec4P2: Tshedimosetso e e golaganeng le ditshekatsheko di tshegetsa dipoelo tsa kgwebo tse di tswelelang pele ka:

sec4List.text: Go dira dilo mo pepeneneng go go tswelelang go ralala thekiso, lenaane la dithoto, go diragatsa, le tiragatso ya matlole.

sec4List.bold: Dikgato tsa go bega ka bonako:
sec4List.text: Kokoanyo ya tshedimosetso fa e batliwa e e fedisang diseporeteshiti tse di boaboelediwang ka diatla.
Ditlhaloso tse di le nosi tsa dimeteriki tse di jaaka molelwane, boleng jwa botshelo jotlhe jwa khasetomara, le lebelo la go etelela pele.

sec4List.bold: Dintlha tse di botoka tsa kgwebo:
sec4List.text: Go lemoga paterone e e bonelwang pele e e tlhagisang dikotsi le ditšhono pele ga nako.

sec4List.bold: Go tsaya ditshwetso go go tokafaditsweng:
sec4List.text: Kgato ya khuduthamaga e e nang le boitshepo e e tshegediwang ke losika lwa tshedimosetso lo lo netefaditsweng le go nna mo pepeneneng.

artificialIntelligence.sec1Eyebrow: PHETOGO YA GO YA BOTLHALENG JWA BATHO
artificialIntelligence.sec1Subtext: Botlhale jwa maitirelo bo fetoga go tswa mo diporojekeng tsa ka fa thoko tsa ditekelelo go ya kwa ditirisong tsa konokono tsa tiro tse dikgwebo di ikaegileng ka tsone letsatsi le letsatsi.
artificialIntelligence.sec2Subtext: Go feta dikwalwa tse di tlwaelegileng tse di theilweng mo melaong go ya kwa dithulaganyong tsa tiro tsa tlhaloganyo tse di tlhaloganyang diteng tse di sa rulaganngwang, tse di tlwaelanang le dipharologano, le go tokafatsa dithulaganyo ka maatla.
artificialIntelligence.sec3Subtext: Ba theilwe mo kitsong ya mokgatlho le tshireletsego ya kgwebo, bathusi ba AI ba dira jaaka balekane ba ba kgethegileng go ralala ditiro tsa letsatsi le letsatsi tsa kgwebo.
artificialIntelligence.sec4Subtext: Go fetola dipego tsa kgwebo tsa hisitori le diphepo tsa tiro tsa nako ya nnete go nna ponelopele e e ka tsewang kgato.
artificialIntelligence.sec5Heading: Dikgetse tsa Tiriso ya AI ya Kgwebo
artificialIntelligence.sec5Subtext: Ditsela tse di mosola tse mekgatlho e e eteletseng pele e dirisang botlhale jwa maitirelo go ralala ditiro tsa konokono tsa kgwebo.
artificialIntelligence.sec6Subtext: Fa e tsenngwa tirisong ka kelotlhoko ka tshedimosetso ya kgwebo e e laolwang, AI e lotlolola melemo e e bonalang ya boleng.
artificialIntelligence.ctaHeading: Batlisisa Ditšhono tsa AI tsa Kgwebo ya Gago
artificialIntelligence.ctaDescription: Ribolola ka fao go itirisa go go botlhale, di-copilot tsa kgwebo le dikai tse di bonelapele di ka lotlololang bokgoni jwa go dira mo ditsamaisong tsotlhe tsa gago tsa konokono.
artificialIntelligence.sec1P1: Ka dingwaga, botlhale jwa maitirelo jwa kgwebo bo ne bo tsewa jaaka bokgoni jwa kwa ntle: sekao se se katisitsweng se le nosi, pontsho ya lebokoso la motlhaba, kgotsa chatbot e e kgaoganeng e e ka fitlhelelwang ka kgoro e e farologaneng. Gompieno, paradigm e fetogile gotlhelele. AI ya kgwebo e e nang le tlhotlheletso e kgolo e tsentswe ka tlhamalalo mo teng ga ditsamaiso tsa direkoto—di-ERP, di-CRM, dipolatefomo tsa batho le dienjini tsa ketane ya tlamelo koo kgwebo ya mmatota e diragalang gone.
artificialIntelligence.sec1P2: Fa botlhale bo dira mo teng ga tsamaiso ya direkoto, bo rua melelwane ya tshireletsego e e tlhomilweng ya mokgatlho, dikai tsa tshedimosetso, le tlhaloganyo ya kgwebo. Ga e tlhagise fela dikarabo tse di akaretsang; e sebetsa ka ditaelo tse phelang, e hlalosa ditekete tse bulehileng tsa tshehetso, e kopanya ditshupamolato tsa bafepedi, mme e thusa basebetsi ka hara di-interface tse tobileng tseo ba di tsamayang letsatsi le letsatsi.
artificialIntelligence.sec1P3: Phetogo eno e sutisa dirweboleta tsa kgwebo go tswa mo dipolokelongtshedimosetso tse di sa direng sepe tse di letetseng go tobediwa ga dikonopo tsa batho go ya kwa dipolatefomong tse di dirang tse di bonelang pele ditlhokego, dikgato tse di itirisang, le dikgakololo tse di tlhagelelang ka nako.
artificialIntelligence.sec2P1: Go Itirisa ga Thulaganyo ya Diroboto ga Setso (RPA) go ne go dira sentle thata mo go tlhotlhomiseng sekerini ka tsela e e tlhomameng, e e boaboelediwang. Le fa go ntse jalo, ditlhopha tsa melao e e gagametseng di a thubega nako le nako fa foromo e fetoga, thulaganyo ya tokomane e e sa lebelelwang e goroga, kgotsa go diragala mokgwa o o sa tlwaelegang. Go itirisa go go botlhale go thibela karogano eno ka go kopanya go akanya ka tlhaloganyo le go diragatsa tirisano:

sec2List.bold: Go itirisa ga kelelo ya tiro:
sec2List.text: Go rulaganya ditiro tse di raraaneng tsa mafapha otlhe, go tsamaisa ditiro go ikaegilwe ka ditsela tsa tharabololo tsa potlako le tsa hisitori.
Go tsenya di-PDF tse di sa rulaganngwang, diimeile, dimanifeste tsa thomelo, le dikonteraka, go di fetolela go nna ditirisano tsa polokelotshedimosetso tse di rulagantsweng.

sec2List.bold: Go itirisa ga tiro ka botlhale:
sec2List.text: Go itirisa dinetefatso tsa tiro tsa dikgato tse dintsi—tse di jaaka go tshwantshanya diotara tsa theko kgatlhanong le dirasiti le ditatamente tsa banka.

Go tswelela go sekaseka dipego tsa thulaganyo go supa dikgoreletsi tsa nako ya modikologo le go akantsha ditokafatso tse di ikaeletsweng tsa kelelo ya tiro.

copilotCards.desc: Go simolola ditirisano ka tlhamalalo go tswa mo dipotso tsa motlotlo—tse di jaaka go rulaganya didirisiwa, go tlhama ditekete, go tlhabolola direkoto, kgotsa go romela dikopo tsa go reka.

copilotCards.title: Phitlhelelo e e Theilweng mo Seabeng

artificialIntelligence.sec4P1: Le fa dikai tse di tlhagisang di dira sentle thata mo go tlhaloganyeng le go kopanya puo, botlhale jwa go bonela pele bo tlhoma mogopolo mo dipateroneng tsa dipalo tse di fitlhegileng mo teng ga ditlhopha tsa tshedimosetso tsa kgwebo tse di rulagantsweng. Dikai tse di tsenngwang tsa go bonela pele di naya mekgatlho maatla a go bonela pele dikgoreletsi tsa tiro pele ga di kgoreletsa ditiro:

sec4List.text: Go bonela pele diphetogo tsa lotseno, lebelo la lenaane la dithoto, le ditlhokego tsa didirisiwa ka go kopanya ditshupo tsa paka ka lebelo la dipeipi tsa nako ya nnete.
Go supa dikotsi tsa go tlhokafala ga bareki, ditikologo tsa go senyega ga tlhokomelo, le ditiego tsa ketane ya tlamelo fa go santse go na le nako ya go tsereganya.
Go tshwaya diphoso mo ditirisanong tsa matlole, dipego tsa kobamelo, le diphethene tsa theko ya barekisi pele ga di gola.
Go dumalanya diponelopele tsa thekiso le bokgoni jwa go dira le maemo a setoko sa bobolokelo go sireletsa matlotlo a a dirang.

modernErp.sec1Heading: Goreng ERP ya Segompieno e le Botlhokwa
modernErp.sec1Subtext: ERP ga e tlhole e le fela diakhaonto tsa kwa morago ga ofisi. Ke mohlala tshebetso ya kgwebo ea kajeno hlahiswa ka mananeo a khomphuteng.
modernErp.sec2Heading: Ditiro tsa Kgwebo tse di Golaganeng
modernErp.sec2Subtext: Boleng jwa nnete jwa mokgatlho bo tlhagelela fa ditiro tsa konokono tsa kgwebo di dira mmogo mo motheong o o abelanwang wa dijithale.
modernErp.sec3Eyebrow: KUTLWANO YA DITIRO TSE DI TLHAGISANG
modernErp.sec3Heading: Ditiro tse di Kopantsweng le Kelelo ya Tshedimosetso
modernErp.sec3Subtext: Go thuba mabota a tlhaeletsano magareng ga mafapha go kgontsha dithulaganyo tsa tiro tsa kgwebo tse di tsamayang sentle, tse di tsamaelanang.
modernErp.sec4Heading: Go bonala ga Kgwebo ka Nako ya Mmatota
modernErp.sec4Subtext: Go kopanya dimeteriki tsa tiro go nna didesheboto tsa khuduthamaga tse di bonaletsang tse di bontshang bonnete jwa ga jaana jwa kgwebo.
modernErp.sec5Subtext: Diponagalo tsa boagi tse di kgaoganyang dipolatefomo tsa ERP tsa segompieno le ditlhomo tse di gagametseng tsa bogologolo.
modernErp.sec6Subtext: Go golaganya ditiro tsa konokono tsa kgwebo go nna motheo o o kopaneng wa dijithale go ntsha nonofo ya mokgatlho e e ka lekanngwang.
modernErp.ctaHeading: Dira Ditiro tsa Kgwebo ya Gago tsa Segompieno
modernErp.ctaDescription: Batlisisa ka moo dipolatefomo tsa segompieno tsa ERP di golaganyang matlole, theko, ketane ya tlamelo le ditiro tsa kgwebo ka motheo o o kopaneng wa dijithale.
modernErp.sec1P1: Mo diponagalong tsa dikgwebo tse di tsamayang ka bonako, ditsamaiso tsa tlwaelo tsa Thulaganyo ya Didirisiwa tsa Kgwebo gantsi di a kgaratlha. E agilwe mo motlheng wa go dira ka setlhopha le disefara tsa selegae tse di kgaoganeng, di-ERP tsa bogologolo di ne di rulagantswe thata, di le thata go di tlhabolola, e bile di sa bonale sentle. Ditshebetso tsa bohlokwa tsa kgwebo di ne di sebetsa ka di-silo tse tshwanang, di itshetlehile ka diromelwantle tse fokolang tsa bosiu ho nyalanya dibuka tsa ditshenyehelo le matlo a polokelo.
modernErp.sec1P2: ERP ya segompieno, e e tlholegileng mo marung e tlhalosa sešwa maatla ano. E sebetsa e le mokwatla o kopaneng wa dijithale wa kgwebo-motheo o phelang moo ditjhelete, theko, ketane ya phepelo, lenane la dintho tse fumanehang, le mehlodi ya batho di sebetsanang ka mohlala wa data o arolelanwang.
modernErp.sec1P3: Ka go tlisa ditiro tsa konokono mo tikologong e le nngwe e e dumalaneng, ERP ya segompieno e fedisa mafelo a a sa bonaleng a tiro a a fokotsang kgolo, go kgontsha baeteledipele go tsamaisa kgwebo ba dirisa matshwao a nako ya nnete go na le ditshobokanyo tsa hisitori tsa bogologolo.
modernErp.sec3P1: Di-silo tsa tiro ga se gantsi e leng mathata a batho; ke mathata a boagi. Fa ditlhopha tsa tirelo ya bareki, tsa go reka le tsa bobolokelo di dira mo ditirisong tse di sa golaganngwang, go neela gongwe le gongwe go tlhoka diimeile tse di dirwang ka diatla, diseporeteshiti le megala ya founo. Diphoso di a ntsifala, ditshupamolato di a tshwarwa, mme maitlamo a khasetomara a a relela.
modernErp.sec3P2: ERP ya segompieno e rarabolola seno ka losika lo lo kopantsweng lwa tshedimosetso le thulaganyo ya thulaganyo e e tsamaisiwang ke ditiragalo:

sec3List.bold: Otara e e tsamaelanang le madi a a seatleng:
sec3List.text: Fa otara ya khasetomara e tsenngwa, dipeeletso tsa lenaanethoto ka go itirisa, dileibole tsa thomelo di a tlhagisiwa, mme dibuka tsa dituelo di a ntšhwafadiwa ka bonako.

sec3List.bold: Go nna mo pepeneneng ga go reka go duela:
sec3List.text: Diotara tsa theko, dirasiti tsa dithoto, le ditshupamolato tsa barekisi di tshwana ka go itirisa le poelano ya ditsela di le 3, di tshwaya fela dipharologano tsa tshekatsheko ya batho.

sec3List.bold: Ditshenyegelo tsa badiri le tsa tiro tse di kopantsweng:
sec3List.text: Dipampiri tsa nako tsa porojeke, dikabo tsa dituelo, le ditshenyegelo tsa tiro tse di tlhamaletseng di mmapa ka tlhamalalo kwa mafelong a ditshenyegelo ka nako ya nnete.

modernErp.sec4P1: Go tsamaisa kgwebo ntle le ponalo e e kopaneng go tshwana le go fofa mo mouwaneng o o kitlaneng ka didirisiwa tse di diegileng. ERP ya segompieno e tlamela ka telemetry ya nako ya mmatota mo karolong nngwe le nngwe ya kgwebo:

sec4List.bold: Didesheboto tsa khuduthamaga tse di tshelang:
sec4List.text: Dipono tsa ka bonako tsa dipoelo tsotlhe, kelelo ya madi a a dirisiwang, melato e e bulegileng, le diotara tse di saletseng kwa morago kwantle ga go leta go tswalwa ga bokhutlo jwa paka.

sec4List.bold: Pegelo ya tiro ya go itirela:
sec4List.text: Ditlhogo tsa mafapha di ka aga dipotso tse di rulagantsweng le go tlhotlhomisa go tswa mo ditshobokanyo tsa maemo a kgwebo go ya kwa dintlheng tsa mola wa kgwebisano ka bongwe.

sec4List.bold: Tshedimosetso ya konokono e e kopantsweng:
sec4List.text: Go fedisa dinomoro tse di thulanang ka go tlhoma tshedimosetso e le nngwe e e laolwang ya bareki, barekisi, le dikhathaloko tsa dikumo.
Ditsiboso tse di itirisang di itsise batsamaisi ka bonako fa dipoelo di wela ka fa tlase ga selekanyo se se beilweng, lenaane la dithoto le fokotsega, kgotsa dithomelo tsa batlamedi di relela.

cybersecurity.sec1Heading: Sebopego sa Tshireletsego ya Kgwebo e e Golaganeng
cybersecurity.sec1Subtext: Jaaka fa mekgatlho ya segompieno e golaganya ditiriso tse dintsi, ditikologo tsa kwa marung, badiri ba ba kwa kgakala, didiriswa tsa selulafouno, le balekane ba motho wa boraro, molelwane wa tshireletso o o tlwaelegileng o kgaotsa go nna teng.
cybersecurity.sec2Subtext: Diphemelo tse di dirang tse di sireletsang mafaratlhatlha a a botlhokwa, tshedimosetso e e botlhokwa ya kgwebo, le ditsamaiso tsa tiriso.
cybersecurity.sec3Subtext: Boitshupo ke sefofane sa taolo sa motheo sa tshireletsego ya segompieno. Mo e ka nnang ditlolo tsotlhe tse di masisi tsa tshireletsego di simolola ka dintlha tsa boitshupo tse di tsenngwang mo kotsing go na le go dirisa dirweboleta ka tsela e e sa siamang.
cybersecurity.sec4Heading: Go Tlhalosa Boagi jwa Terasete ya Lefela
cybersecurity.sec4Subtext: Zero Trust ga se setlhagiswa kgotsa sediriswa se le sengwe. Ke leano la boagi le le ikaegileng ka molaomotheo o o tlhamaletseng: o se ka wa tshepa setheo sepe se se mo teng kgotsa se se kwa ntle ga neteweke ka thulaganyetsoruri.
cybersecurity.sec5Heading: Dikakanyo tsa Tshireletsego ya kwa Marung
cybersecurity.sec5Subtext: Go sireletsa merwalo ya tiro go ralala maru a botlhe, dipolane tsa dipolane tse di kopantsweng, le ditikologo tsa ditshodi tse di anamisitsweng.
cybersecurity.sec6Heading: Go Ipaakanyetsa Tiragalo: Go Feta Thibelo
cybersecurity.sec6Subtext: Boitsetsepelo jwa nnete jwa inthanete bo amogela gore ditiragalo di ka diragala. Go ipaakanyetsa go tlhomile mogopolo mo go thibeleng ka bonako, go kgoreletsa kgwebo go le gonnye, le go boela mannong go go netefaditsweng.
cybersecurity.sec7Subtext: Go aga kgwebo e e kgonang go emelana le inthanete go sireletsa boleng jwa mokgatlho, boemo jwa taolo, le leina le lentle mo mmarakeng.
cybersecurity.ctaHeading: Nonotsha Tshireletsego ya Kgwebo ya Gago
cybersecurity.ctaDescription: Batlisisa ka moo mekgatlho e ka nonotshang tshireletsego ka teng, ya sireletsa ditsamaiso tse di botlhokwa le go ipaakanyetsa matshosetsi go ralala ditikologo tse di golaganeng thata.
cybersecurity.sec1P1: Mo motlheng wa boswa jwa IT ya dikgwebo, tshireletsego e ne e dira ka thuto ya castle-and-moat: sengwe le sengwe se se mo teng ga mafaratlhatlha a diofisi tsa dikhamphani se ne se tsewa se a ikanyega, fa sengwe le sengwe se se kwa ntle se ne se tsewa se sa ikanyege. Lebota le le lengwe la molelo la khamphani le ne le sireletsa disefara tsa ka fa teng, dipolokelotshedimosetso le dikhomphutara tsa tafole.
cybersecurity.sec1P2: Kgwebo ya gompieno e godile go feta mabota a mmatota. Merwalo ya tiro e nna mo ditikologong tsa maru a mantsi (AWS, Azure, GCP), badiri ba fitlhelela ditiriso tsa kgwebo go tswa kwa mafelong a a farologaneng, mme di-API di tswelela go ananya tshedimosetso e e botlhokwa ya tiro le batlamedi ba dithulaganyo tsa kwa ntle, ditheo tsa matlole, le barekisi ba SaaS.
cybersecurity.sec1P3: Le fa kgolagano eno e e feteletseng e dira gore kgwebo e nne le bofefo jo bogolo, e atolosa thata lefelo la tlhaselo ya kgwebo. Ntlha nngwe le nngwe ya bofelo ya API, letshwao la boitshupo, sediriswa sa selulafouno se se golagantsweng, le go kopanngwa ga SaaS di emela vector e e ka nnang teng ya go tlhagelela. Tshireletso ya nnete ya kgwebo e tlhoka go fetoga go tswa mo tshireletsong e e theilweng mo tikologong go ya kwa go itshokeleng ga inthanete go go dirang, go tswa kwa bofelong go ya kwa bofelong.

sec2Cards.title: Go Lemoga Matshosetsi
sec2Cards.desc: Botlhale jwa matshosetsi jo bo thusiwang ke go ithuta ka motšhini jo bo tlhokomelang diphethene tse di sa tlwaelegang tsa neteweke, tirisobotlhaswa ya dintlha tsa boitshupo, le makoa a letsatsi la lefela ka nako ya mmatota.

sec2Cards.title: Tlhokomelo ya Tshireletsego
sec2Cards.desc: Telemetry ya Setheo sa Ditiro tsa Tshireletso e e Bogare (SOC) e e amanyang ditiragalo go ralala disefara, ditlhopha tsa ditshodi, batlamedi ba boitshupo, le dintlha tsa bofelo.

sec2Cards.title: Taolo ya Matshosetsi
sec2Cards.desc:
Go tswelela go sekaseka makoa a a itirisang go ralala mafaratlhatlha, mabolokelo a khoutu ya motswedi, le dikwadiso tsa ditshodi go baakanya makoa ka bonako.

sec2Cards.title: Tshireletso ya Tshedimosetso
sec2Cards.desc: Go tsenya tshedimosetso e e nonofileng mo tseleng (TLS 1.3) le mo boikhutsong (AES-256), mmogo le puso ya thibelo ya tatlhegelo ya tshedimosetso ya dithoro (DLP) go thibela go dutla ga dithoto tsa tlhaloganyo.

cybersecurity.sec3P1: Go sireletsa dithoto tsa kgwebo go tlhoka go netefatsa gore boitshupo bongwe le bongwe—e ka tswa e le mokhuduthamaga wa motho, rakonteraka wa kwa ntle, kgotsa akhaonto ya tirelo ya serweboleta se se ikemetseng—bo na le tetlelelo e e netefaditsweng ya didirisiwa tse di tlhomameng tse e di fitlhelelang.

sec3List.bold: Taolo ya boitshupo e e kopantsweng:
sec3List.text: Go Tsena ka Gangwe (SSO) le maemo a boitshupo a a kopantsweng a a fedisang mabenkele a a kgaoganeng a dikhunololamoraba mo ditirisong tsotlhe.

sec3List.bold: Netefatso ya mabaka a mantsi e e tlwaelegang (MFA):
sec3List.text: Dinotlolo tsa serweboleta sa FIDO2 se se kgonang go emelana le phishing le dikgwetlho tsa bokao tse di theilweng mo dikotsing tsa ditiro tse di masisi tsa tsamaiso.
Ditaolo tsa phitlhelelo tse di Theilweng mo Seabeng (RBAC) le tse di Theilweng mo Diponagalong (ABAC) tse di gapelediwang mo maemong a API le a polokelotshedimosetso.
Go neelana ka phitlhelelo ya nakwana, ya nako fela (JIT) e e felelwang ke nako ka go itirisa fa ditiro tsa tsamaiso di wediwa.

cloudSecurityCards.title: Maikarabelo a a Kopanetsweng
cloudSecurityCards.desc: Puso e e tlhapileng e e farologanyang tshireletsego ya mafaratlhatlha a sebele a motlamedi wa maru le maikarabelo a kgwebo a go tsenya tshedimosetso, dipholisi tsa IAM, le khoutu ya tiriso.

cloudSecurityCards.title: Mafaratlhatlha jaaka Khoutu (IaC)
cloudSecurityCards.desc: Dithulaganyo tsa maru tse di sa fetogeng, tse di ka tlhatlhobiwang tse di laolwang ka khoutu. Di-scanner tse di itirisang tsa pholisi-jaaka-khoutu di thibela dithulaganyo tse di sa siamang le dikgamelo tse di senotsweng pele ga go dirisiwa.

cloudSecurityCards.title: Tshireletsego ya Ditshodi le Kubernetes
cloudSecurityCards.desc: Dinako tsa go dira ga ditshodi tse di thatafaditsweng, dikwadiso tsa ditshwantsho tse di saenilweng, karoganyo e nnye ya neteweke, le taolo ya sephiri e e itirisang e e bolokang dintlha tsa boitshupo di se mo mabolokelong a motswedi.

cloudArchitectureFlow.title: Boagi jo bo ikaeletsweng
cloudArchitectureFlow.desc: Dipolane tsa ditirelopotlana tsa dimojule, ditopologo tsa ditshodi, le dithempoleite tsa IaC tse di itirisang.

cloudArchitectureFlow.title: Phudugo ya Dikgato

cloudModernizationBenefits: Ditshenyegelo tse di kwa tlase thata tsa go tlhokomela mafaratlhatlha le go tsosolosa serwethata
Go tshwaragana le pharakano e e kwa godimo ya kgwebo e e nang le tiego ya lefela
Lebelo le le potlakileng la go gololwa ka dipeipi tsa go dirisa CI/CD tse di itirisang ka botlalo
Go fedisiwa ga dintlha di le dingwe tsa go palelwa ka go nna teng ga di-AZ tse dintsi
Dipolane tsa segompieno tsa API tse di kgontshang go kopanngwa ka bonako ga balekane ba dipolatefomo tse di farologaneng
Go kgona go ela tlhoko ka nako ya mmatota mo tirong ya tiriso le tiriso ya madi mo marung
landscapeAssessmentPoints: Go dira mmapa wa ditiriso tse di farologaneng tse di raraaneng le go nyalanya tshedimosetso
Go supa dithulaganyo tsa tikologo tse di nang le khoutu e e thata le dikema tsa polokelotshedimosetso ya mong
Go sekaseka kobamelo ya melawana le dikgoreletsi tsa boipuso jwa tshedimosetso go ya ka taolo
Go balela Palogotlhe ya Ditshenyegelo tsa Bong (TCO) mo ditseleng tsa refactor fa di bapisiwa le tsa go amogela gape
Go tlhoma makhubu a a bonalang a go phasalatsa go sireletsa ditiro tsa kgwebo tsa letsatsi le letsatsi tse di matlhagatlhaga
cloudModernization.sec1Subtext: Di-monolith tse di tsofetseng di thibela lebelo la boitshimololedi, di oketsa makoa a tiriso, le go oketsa ditshenyegelo tsa tlhokomelo ya mafaratlhatlha.
cloudModernization.sec2Subtext: Go dira gore maru e nne a segompieno ka katlego go simolola ka go sekaseka ka kelotlhoko. Go tlolela ka tlhamalalo mo go fudugeng kwantle ga go tlhatlhoba ditshegetso tsa tiriso ke selo se segolo se se bakang go diega ga go kgaola.
cloudModernization.sec3Subtext: Ga go na leano la go fuduga le le tshwanelang botlhe. Dikgwebo tse di eteletseng pele di tshwantshanya mokgwa o o siameng wa go dira dilo tsa segompieno le morwalo mongwe le mongwe o o rileng wa tiro go ikaegilwe ka boleng jwa kgwebo, go potlaka, le sekoloto sa setegeniki.
cloudModernization.sec4Eyebrow: MOTLHOLO WA PHETOGO O O LEBILENG
cloudModernization.sec4Subtext: Mmapa wa tsela o o rulagantsweng o o fetolang di-monolith tsa bogologolo go nna ditirelo tsa kwa marung tse di elastic, tse di sireletsegileng, le tse di ka tlhokomelwang.
cloudModernization.sec5Subtext: Go sutisetsa ditsamaiso tsa bogologolo mo dipolaneteng tsa segompieno tsa maru go tlisa bofefo jo bo bonalang jwa go dira le go bonela pele ditshenyegelo.
cloudModernization.ctaHeading: Dira Ditiriso tsa Gago tsa Bogologolo tsa segompieno
cloudModernization.ctaDescription: Batlisisa mokgwa o o mosola wa go sekaseka, go dira gore ditiriso di nne tsa segompieno le go sutisetsa ditiriso tsa bogologolo go ya kwa dipolane tsa maru tse di ka lekanyediwang, tse di sireletsegileng.
cloudModernization.sec1P1: Ditiriso tse di botlhokwa thata tse di agilweng dingwaga di le lesome tse di fetileng di sa ntse di kgweetsa dibilione tsa lotseno lwa dikgwebo, le fa go ntse jalo go gagamala ga tsone ga kago go dira gore go nne le kotsi e e golang ya go dira.
cloudModernization.sec1P2: Kgwebo nngwe le nngwe e lebane le tsitsipano magareng ga go tlhomama le go dira dilo tsa segompieno. Ditsamaiso tsa bogologolo di ne di diretswe gore di nne lobaka lo loleele, mme di ntse di dira ka tsela e e ikanyegang ka dingwaga di le dintsi. Le fa go ntse jalo, fa ditlhokego tsa kgwebo di ntse di oketsega, dipolane tseno tse di tsofetseng di kopana le melelwane ya popego:

sec1List.bold: Ditlhopha tsa dirweboleta tse di tsofetseng:
sec1List.text: Dikhoutu tsa monolithic tse di agilweng mo matlhomesong a a sa tlholeng a dirisiwa a a nang le matangwana a ditalente a a fokotsegang a a leng teng go ka tlhokomelwa.

sec1List.bold: Ditshekeletsa tse di thata tsa tlhokomelo:
sec1List.text: Dikarolo tse di kopantsweng thata moo go fetola ntlha e le nngwe go tsenyang kotsi ya go thuba dimmojulu tsa tiriso tse di sa amaneng.
Ditekanyetso tsa go lekanyetsa tse di emeng tse di tlhokang go reka serweboleta se se turang sa mong go samagana le ditlhatlogo tsa pharakano tsa paka.
Go palelwa ke go dirisana ka thelelo le ditiriso tsa segompieno tsa selulafouno, di-portal tsa bareki, kgotsa di-API tsa balekane kwantle ga dikwalwa tsa setlhopha tse di bokoa.
Ditshekeletsa tsa botshelo tsa phaposi ya sefara ya mmatota, makoa a bekapo, le ditshenyegelo tse di kwa godimo tsa maatla/tsidifatso ya tiro.

cloudModernization.sec2P1: Leeto la segompieno le le mosola le simolola ka go tlhomamisa tlhaloso e e feletseng go ralala boswa jo bo leng teng:

sec2List.text: Go dira lenaane la ditiro tsotlhe tse di dirang, dimmojulu tse di tlwaelegileng, dikwalwa tsa lemorago, le diphuthelwana tsa motho yo mongwe tsa hisitori.

Go dira mmapa wa go kopanya nako e e raraaneng ya go dira, ditafole tsa polokelotshedimosetso tse di abelanwang, dipitso tsa tsamaiso ya difaele tse di tlhamaletseng, le dikonteraka tsa tirelo tsa kwa ntle.
Tshedimosetso:
Go sekaseka dibopego tsa tshedimosetso, ditlhokego tsa bothokgami jwa kgwebisano, cadence ya bekapo, le melawana ya boipuso jwa taolo.
Go tlhatlhoba CPU, memori, tiriso ya polokelo, le go feta ga neteweke go ya ka ditlhaloso tsa maru tse di ikaeletsweng tsa bogolo jo bo siameng.
Go aroganya ditiriso ka dikarolo go tlhama makhubu a a babalesegileng, a a rulagantsweng ka dikgato a a nang le ditsamaiso tse di tlhamaletseng tsa go boela morago.

cloudModernization.sec4P1: Popego ya lefelo le le yang teng e kgaoganya ditiriso tsa konokono go nna ditirelo tsa dimojule, tse di tsenngwang mo ditshoding tse di amogelwang mo dipolatefomong tsa maru tse di elastic (tse di jaaka Kubernetes kgotsa dinako tsa go dira tse di laolwang tse di senang sefara).
cloudModernization.sec4P2: Ka go tlhoma dipeipi tsa go tsenngwa tirisong ga CI/CD tse di itirisang, di-cutover tse di itirisang tsa botala jwa loapi, le mafaratlhatlha jaaka khoutu, go tsenngwa tirisong go fetoga go tswa mo ditiragalong tsa mafelobeke tse di tlhobaetsang go nna ditiro tsa letsatsi le letsatsi tse di senang mathata.
cloudModernization.sec4P3: Elastic compute e tlhatloga ka go itirisa ka nako ya go tlhatloga ga tlhokego mme e fokotsega ka nako ya go iketla, e fedisa ditshenyegelo tsa didirisiwa tse di sa direng sepe fa e ntse e netefatsa dinako tsa karabo tsa bobedi jwa badirisi ba lefatshe lotlhe.
